faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Samagra Shiksha Bemetara Music Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Samagra Shiksha Bemetara Music Instructor positions is 15th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Music Instructor post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Music Instructor position, candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Music or an equivalent qualification from a university or institution recognized by the government.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Music Instructor post?
faq.answer: Samagra Shiksha Bemetara has announced a total of 7 vacancies for the Music Instructor position through this recruitment drive. This offers a good number of opportunities for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Music Instructor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Music Instructor post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 10,000. This is a part-time position, and the salary is fixed as per the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Samagra Shiksha Bemetara Music Instructor recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Music Instructor positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Music Instructor role will be based on a merit list, which will consider 80% of qualification marks and 20% of experience marks. This will be followed by a document verification stage.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for Samagra Shiksha Bemetara?
faq.answer: The official website for Samagra Shiksha Bemetara, where candidates can find more information and download the application form, is https://bemetara.gov.in/. It is advisable to check this website regularly for updates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Music Instructor position?
faq.answer: The Music Instructor position is a part-time job. This means that the selected candidates will be required to work for a specific duration or number of hours per day/week as per the terms of employment.
